# Interactives

Every interactive widget in the course, grouped by the module that
introduces it. Open one on its own for the whole screen, or go to its
lesson for the reasoning around it.

## Four Cuts, Four Antennas

The same four pattern cuts, E-plane and H-plane in co-pol and cross-pol, on a
dipole, a small loop, a patch, and a horn. The antenna view shows what each cut
means; the chamber view shows how a turntable and a source horn take it. Lesson
9 uses the dipole; this is the full tool.

## Module 1: Foundations of Electromagnetics and Antennas

- **HPBW, FNBW, and SLL move with aperture size** (L2). Rectilinear pattern features. <a href="viz/pattern-features.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module01/L02-antenna-properties/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **Effective aperture vs gain and frequency** (L2). Effective aperture vs gain and frequency. <a href="viz/effective-area.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module01/L02-antenna-properties/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **From a line to an ellipse to a circle** (L3). Polarization playground. <a href="viz/polarization-playground.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module01/L03-polarization-bandwidth/index.html">Lesson</a>

## Module 2: Antenna Types, Simulation, and Measurement

- **Resonance on the Smith Chart** (L7). Smith chart showing how a dipole's input impedance moves as its length changes, with constant-VSWR circles. <a href="viz/dipole-smith.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module02/L07-simple-resonant-antennas/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **The Dipole Explorer** (L7). Dipole explorer: current, pattern, beamwidth, directivity and feed-point impedance against dipole length. <a href="viz/dipole-explorer.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module02/L07-simple-resonant-antennas/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **Convergence** (L8). Method-of-moments dipole: solved segment currents against the assumed sinusoid, the feed voltage and current that set the input impedance, and impedance versus segment count. <a href="viz/mom-dipole.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module02/L08-dipole-simulation-lab/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **The Nulls Fill First** (L9). Quadratic phase error from a finite range length, and the pattern it produces compared with the true far-field pattern. <a href="viz/range-phase-error.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module02/L09-pattern-measurement-theory/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **Four Cuts of One Dipole** (L9). A half-wave dipole in 3-D with its pattern, the cut plane, and a probe horn: choose E-plane or H-plane and co-pol or cross-pol, or set the dipole mount and horn polarization as on a chamber turntable. <a href="viz/pol-cuts.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module02/L09-pattern-measurement-theory/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **Rehearse the Chart First** (L10). An antenna resonance shown as an S11 dip in dB and as a Smith-chart locus, with linked marker, impedance, VSWR, and VSWR-2 bandwidth readouts. <a href="viz/s11-smith.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module02/L10-measurement-lab-sparams/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **How Much of Your Pattern Is Real** (L11). A true radiation pattern compared with the same pattern measured through a receiver with a finite noise floor. <a href="viz/pattern-floor.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module02/L11-measurement-lab-patterns/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **Height Above Ground** (L12). An antenna over a perfect ground plane, its image, and the resulting upper-half-space pattern. <a href="viz/image-theory.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module02/L12-loop-monopole-antennas/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **The Patch: A Half-Wave Line Open at Both Ends** (L13). Animated side view of a patch: a wave launched at one end reflects from both open ends and builds a standing wave, with the fringing fields at the ends and their horizontal parts. <a href="viz/patch-cavity.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module02/L13-patch-slot-horn/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **The Patch Designer** (L13). Rectangular patch designer: the patch to scale with its feed point, VSWR against frequency, and the two-slot pattern. <a href="viz/patch-designer.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module02/L13-patch-slot-horn/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **Gain, Beamwidth, and Surface Error** (L14). Dish gain, beamwidth, and effective area versus diameter in wavelengths, with the Ruze surface-error penalty. <a href="viz/reflector-gain.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module02/L14-high-gain-antennas/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **Dish and Feed** (L14). Dish and feed: the rim angle, edge taper, spillover, and taper efficiency as the dish depth and the feed pattern change. <a href="viz/feed-dish.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module02/L14-high-gain-antennas/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **Two-Element Yagi** (L14). Two-element Yagi: phasor sums toward the front and back, and the resulting pattern, as the reflector's spacing, phase, and amplitude change. <a href="viz/yagi-two-element.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module02/L14-high-gain-antennas/index.html">Lesson</a>

## Module 3: Arrays and ADALM-PHASER Beamforming

- **Illumination and Length** (L15). Aperture illumination and the far-field pattern it produces. <a href="viz/aperture-distribution.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module03/L15-aperture-distributions/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **Phasor Chain Explorer** (L16). Phasor chain: the element phasors added tip to tail for a chosen scan angle, beside the array factor in decibels with a marker at that angle. <a href="viz/phasor-chain.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module03/L16-array-factor/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **Array Factor Builder** (L16). Array factor builder: pattern in dB versus scan angle for N elements at spacing d over lambda, with an optional cosine element factor. <a href="viz/array-factor-builder.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module03/L16-array-factor/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **Visible Region Explorer** (L16). Visible region: the array factor against psi with the window real angles reach, and the same pattern against scan angle, for adjustable N, spacing, and steer angle. <a href="viz/visible-region.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module03/L16-array-factor/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **The Measured Sweep** (L16). Array factor against a simulated measured sweep, with the steer grid and the noise floor on a toggle. <a href="viz/af-measurement-compare.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module03/L16-array-factor/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **Interactive — the PHASER signal chain** (L17). Interactive block diagram of the PHASER receive chain with a tunable HB100 source. <a href="viz/phaser-signal-chain.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module03/L17-phased-array-hardware/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **Phase Ramp and Beam** (L18). Steered pattern and per-element phase ramp for the 8-element course array. <a href="viz/beam-steering.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module03/L18-beam-steering-theory/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **Predicted sweep and wrapped phases** (L19). Predicted beam-sweep trace and wrapped element phases for the PHASER array. <a href="viz/steering-predictor.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module03/L19-beam-steering-lab/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **Where the 0.886 formula holds, and where it doesn't** (L20). Uniform linear array pattern with half-power beamwidth, nulls, first-null beamwidth and directivity. <a href="viz/array-beamwidth.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module03/L20-array-factor-beamwidth/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **Ideal versus measured, on a toggle** (L21). Ideal array factor and measured sweep at 8, 4, and 2 active elements. <a href="viz/af-measurement-compare.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module03/L21-array-factor-lab/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **Interactive — element factor times array factor** (L22). Element factor times array factor for the eight-element course array. <a href="viz/element-pattern-multiplication.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module03/L22-antenna-pattern-theory/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **The trace paints as you walk** (L23). Simulated hand-rotation pattern measurement: a source walks an arc around a fixed beam while the amplitude-versus-time trace paints below. <a href="viz/pattern-measurement-sim.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module03/L23-antenna-pattern-lab/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **Five tapers on the eight-element array** (L24). Element amplitudes, pattern, sidelobe level, beamwidth, taper efficiency and peak drop for five tapers on the eight-element PHASER array. <a href="viz/taper-explorer.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module03/L24-sidelobes-tapering/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **Interactive — the measured sweep for each taper preset** (L25). Measured beam sweep for the PHASER taper presets, with element gains, HPBW, peak drop and taper efficiency. <a href="viz/taper-measurement.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module03/L25-tapering-lab/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **Interactive — grating, squint, and phase quantization on the course array** (L26). Grating lobes, beam squint and phase quantization on the 8-element course array. <a href="viz/squint-quantization.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module03/L26-beam-squint-quantization/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **Null steering on the 8-element PHASER array** (L27). Null steering on the 8-element PHASER array: pattern, element weights, and null depth. <a href="viz/null-steering.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module03/L27-null-steering-theory/index.html">Lesson</a>
- **What MVDR chooses** (L28). Two-channel MVDR beamformer against an interferer. <a href="viz/mvdr-interferer.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open</a> · <a href="module03/L28-null-steering-lab/index.html">Lesson</a>
